hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *package-lock.json) echo 'package-lock.json is managed by npm; run npm install instead of editing it directly' >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.ts) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npm run typecheck --silent >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { npm run typecheck --silent && npm test; } >&2 || exit 2
